quiz.src.crater: LRO CRaTER hourly dose rate, NASA OSDR RadLab
quiz.src.donki: DONKI flare list (CCMC, NASA Goddard) and LRO CRaTER
quiz.src.radio: Earth–Moon laser ranging: about 2.5 s there and back
quiz.emergency.q: Night {day}: the backup tank switched on. Why?
quiz.emergency.why: Air and water reached 0. The crew uses {use} days of it every day.
quiz.filter.q: Day {day}: the water filter got clogged. What happens if you wait?
quiz.filter.why.wait: You waited: a clogged filter takes 1 day every night. Day {day}: {from} → {to}.
quiz.filter.why.swap: A clogged filter takes 1 day every night. You swapped it for 1 battery. Day {day}: {from} → {to}.
quiz.ice.q: Day {day}: ice in a dark crater. Why is ice precious on the Moon?
quiz.ice.why: In {year}, LCROSS hit a dark crater at the south pole and found water ice.
quiz.reserve.q: The crew uses air and water every day. What fills it back up?
quiz.reserve.why: Each Life Support battery adds 1 day. The crew uses {use} a day. After day {day}: {air} left.
quiz.flare.q: Day {day}: the Sun made a huge {cls} flash. What did the radiation meter show?
quiz.flare.why.calm: Flare {cls}, yet only {ratio}× normal. A bright flash is not always a storm.
quiz.flare.why.high: Flare {cls}, and {ratio}× normal at the base. That flash brought a real storm.
quiz.times.q: Day {day}: how many times stronger than normal was the radiation?
quiz.times.why: The meter measured {ratio}× normal on day {day}. Each storm level is 10× the one before.
quiz.alert.q: Day {day} was an alert day. Why was the storm level “?”
quiz.alert.why: An alert means the Sun flared. The strength is known only after: day {day} was {ratio}× normal.
quiz.shelter.q: Day {day}: radiation rose at the base. Where is the crew safest?
quiz.shelter.why.full: Inside blocks the most. Day {day}: everyone inside, {pct}% blocked.
quiz.shelter.why.half: Inside blocks the most. Day {day}: half a day inside, {pct}% blocked.
quiz.shelter.why.none: Inside blocks the most. Day {day}: you kept working, {pct}% blocked.
quiz.wall.q: Day {day}: you built the shield wall higher. When does it protect?
quiz.wall.why: A new level works from the next day. Each level blocks {pct}% of a storm. Wall: level {level}.
quiz.shadow.q: Day {day}: a ridge shadow chilled the garden. What keeps plants alive?
quiz.shadow.why.heat: Heat from a battery keeps plants alive. Day {day}: you heated it, so the cold took nothing.
quiz.shadow.why.heatLow: Heat keeps plants alive: the cold took nothing. But the greenhouse needs batteries too: {from} → {to}.
quiz.shadow.why.cool: Heat from a battery keeps plants alive. Day {day}: you let it cool, the cold took 1.
quiz.garden.why: 0 batteries: −1 · 1: stays · 2: +1. After day {day}: garden {plant} of {max}.
quiz.dust.q: Day {day}: dust covered the solar wing. What if you leave it?
quiz.dust.why.brush: Dust takes 1 battery every day. Day {day}: you brushed it, 1 battery only once.
quiz.dust.why.leave: Dust takes 1 battery every day. Day {day}: you left it, so it kept taking.
quiz.sunrise.q: Day {day}: the Sun rose early. What did the base get?
quiz.sunrise.why: Sun on the solar wing means power: day {day} had 1 battery more.
quiz.tired.q: Day {day}: the crew slept badly. What helps them most?
quiz.tired.why.rest: Rest makes a tired crew stronger. Day {day}: you let them rest.
quiz.tired.why.push: Rest makes a tired crew stronger. Day {day}: you pushed on, they got more tired.
quiz.peak.q: Which day so far had the strongest radiation?
quiz.gravity.q: Why can you jump so high on the Moon?
quiz.gravity.why: Moon {moon} m/s², Earth {earth} m/s². The same jump goes about {times}× higher.
quiz.radio.q: How long does a radio call from Earth take?
quiz.radio.why: {km} km at the speed of light: about {s} seconds.
